coverage_definition: Main successful preparations of knightol, knightol acetate and knightal, three approaches to 10, diagnostic epoxide assignment and characterized side branches. Transient bromohydrin/diol graphs and unresolved mixture components remain explicit boundaries; not an assertion of individually characterized complete intermediates.

issues.detail: The synthesized targets are knightol, knightol acetate and knightal. Knightine 4 and family compounds 5-8 shown for context are not synthesized.
SI page 18 procedure calls substrate 22; source drawing, main scheme and substrate mass identify 21. Preserve original label and correction.
issues.subject: E16

issues.detail: Canonical component graphs do not imply pure material. 72% is combined epoxide yield after four recycling cycles. SI-6 diagnostic ratios are not automatically assigned to each subsequent isolate.
issues.subject: 9/SI-5/SI-6/25

issues.detail: 47% belongs to monocyclized ester mixture; 18% knightol and 17% compound 25 are overall from SI-5 over cyclization and reduction. 13% macrodiolide is a separate unresolved mixture.
issues.subject: E25

issues.detail: One source-depicted macrodiolide component only; further stereoisomers and geometries not fully enumerated.
issues.subject: SI-7-representative

issues.detail: Preparative sequences retain grouped hydroboration/oxidation, bromohydrin/cyclization and epoxide cleavage. Transient uncharacterized structures are not separately assigned.
issues.subject: E03/E05/E06

issues.detail: Unassigned phosphonate alpha configurations and epoxide 13 configuration remain unspecified. Distal epoxide components are interpreted using source diagnostic SI-6 assignments; macroester B/C and 25 new alkene geometry remains unspecified.
Source tetraene crude and isolated masses are inconsistent. Recycling paragraphs contain mmol/micromol inconsistencies; do not derive normalized quantities from these.
issues.subject: tetraene/E22

issues.detail: SI page 32 mislabels knightol comparison as knightol acetate. Synthetic/natural rotations differ, especially 2 and 3; source comparison is not independent identity verification.
Acetylation SI uses triethylamine/DMAP at room temperature versus scheme pyridine at 0 C; aldehyde oxidation procedure 4 h versus scheme 3 h. Conditions not fully normalized.
issues.subject: E26/E27
